quotes.text: Stand behind the sled and grab hold of the handles with both hands.

quotes.text: Grab the sled handles at roughly their center.

quotes.text: Step back so your body leans forward from your head through your hips in a straight line. Your shoulders should be straight behind your hands.

quotes.text: Assume a staggered stance, and lean forward so that your spine is parallel to the ground and your lower back is flat.

quotes.text: Get your torso as close to parallel to the ground as possible to get the best angle on the sled.

quotes.text: Keep your arms locked and begin aggressively driving forward with your legs.

quotes.text: Ensure your elbows are fully extended and locked out, your back is flat, your core and hip muscles are engaged, and you look forward.

quotes.text: Hinge at your hips, ensuring your spine is neutral.
